title: ALGORITHM=INPLACE on a 5.7 partition clause — server rejects the statement
violated_rule: partition clauses accept only ALGORITHM=DEFAULT, LOCK=DEFAULT on 5.7
expected_feedback: CRITICAL: on MySQL 5.7, ADD PARTITION accepts only ALGORITHM=DEFAULT, LOCK=DEFAULT. Naming INPLACE makes the statement fail outright. This is the documented exception to the 'always state the algorithm' rule — omit both clauses on 5.7. On 8.0+ ALGORITHM=INPLACE is supported, and LOCK=NONE additionally works for RANGE/LIST partitions (but not HASH/KEY, and not for REORGANIZE/COALESCE/REBUILD PARTITION).
